questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs that can sequentially replace the * signs and balance the given equation.

34 * 17 * 54 * 18 * 6 * 56
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f24c041897992c3cc6c4761d850005be948112290ef5e2d9a0c34bdb3318f24.png] 

Option 1) : ÷, -, +, ×, =

Given equation : 34 * 17 * 54 * 18 * 6 * 56

After inserting the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 34 ÷ 17 - 54 + 18 × 6 = 56

⇒ __**34 ÷ 17**__ - 54 + 18 × 6 = 56

⇒ 2 - 54 + __**18 × 6**__ = 56

⇒ __**2**__ - 54 __**+ 108**__ = 56

⇒ __**110 - 54**__ = 56

⇒ **56 = 56**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 2) : ×, +, ÷, -, =

Given equation : 34 * 17 * 54 * 18 * 6 * 56

After inserting the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 34 × 17 + 54 ÷ 18 - 6 = 56

⇒ 34 × 17 + __**54 ÷ 18**__ - 6 = 56

⇒ __**34 × 17**__ + 3 - 6 = 56

⇒ __**578 + 3**__ - 6 = 56

⇒ __**581 - 6**__ = 56

⇒ 575 ≠ 56

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : +, ÷, ×, -, =

Given equation : 34 * 17 * 54 * 18 * 6 * 56

After inserting the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 34 + 17 ÷ 54 × 18 - 6 = 56

⇒ 34 + __**17 ÷ 54**__ × 18 - 6 = 56

⇒ 34 + __**0.314 × 18**__ - 6 = 56

⇒ __**34 + 5.66**__ - 6 = 56

⇒ __**39.66 - 6**__ = 56

⇒ 33.66 ≠ 56

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : ÷, -, ×, +, =

Given equation : 34 * 17 * 54 * 18 * 6 * 56

After inserting the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 34 ÷ 17 - 54 × 18 + 6 = 56

⇒ __**34 ÷ 17**__ - 54 × 18 + 6 = 56

⇒ 2 - __**54 × 18**__ + 6 = 56

⇒ __**2**__ - 972 __**+ 6**__ = 56

⇒ __**8 - 972**__ = 56

⇒ - 964 ≠ 56

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"÷, -, +, ×, =".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

7 : 56 :: 11 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

**First number² + First number = Second number** 

 
• 7 : 56 → 7² + 7 = 49 + 7 = 56

Similarly,

 
• 11 : ? → 11² + 11 = 121 + 11 = 132

Hence, the correct answer is **"132".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No police officer is a doctor.

Some doctors are specialists.

All engineers are doctors.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some engineers are police officers.

II. No engineer is a police officer.

III. Some doctors are engineers.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow.
Either conclusion I or II and III follow(s).
Only conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc76320046fc5d2485f30387812952690d35dcf6ec7a4b433f38b969fd191b08.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some engineers are police officers → False (As All engineers are doctors and No police officer is a doctor so, Some engineers are police officers is false)

II. No engineer is a police officer → True (As All engineers are doctors and No police officer is a doctor so, No engineer is a police officer is true)

III. Some doctors are engineers → True (As All engineers are doctors so, Some doctors are engineers is true)

∴ Here, Conclusions II and III are true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusions II and III follow".**

questions.question: The average score (runs/match) of Mithali before the start of the women's national series was 45. In the women's national series of 10 matches, her total score was 500 runs. Find the total number of matches played by her till date, if her new average after the series is 47.5.
questions.solution:
The matches played before the start of the women's national series = x

The average score (runs/match) of Mithali before the start of the women's national series was 45 → 45x ........ (i)

In the women's national series of 10 matches, her total score was 500 runs → 500 ........ (ii)

The total number of matches played by her till date = x + 10

The total number of matches played by her till date, if her new average after the series is 47.5 → (x + 10) × 47.5 ......... (iii)

From equations (i), (ii) and (iii) we get,

⇒ 45x + 500 = (x + 10) × 47.5

⇒ 45x + 500 = 47.5x + 475

⇒ 2.5x = 25

⇒ x = 10

∴ The matches played before the start of the women's national series (x) = 10 matches.

∴ Here, The total number of matches played by her till date = x + 10

The total number of matches played by her till date = 10 + 10

**The total number of matches played by her till date = 20**

Hence, the correct answer is **"20".**

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

Q _ T _ S _ K _ R _ _ K _ R S

options.text: K R Q T S K T
K R Q T S Q T
K R Q T S Q R
K R T R S Q T

questions.solution:
Given :- Q _ T _ S _ K _ R _ _ K _ R S

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) K R Q T S K T → Q **K** T **R** S - **Q** K **T** R **S - K** K **T** R S

2) K R Q T S Q T → Q **K** T **R** S - **Q** K **T** R **S - Q **K **T** R S

 
• Here pattern **"QKTRS"** is repeated.

3) K R Q T S Q R → Q **K** T **R** S - **Q** K **T** R **S - Q **K **R** R S

4) K R T R S Q T → Q **K** T **R** S - **T** K **R** R **S - Q** K **T** R S

 
• Option (2) gives the pattern of :- Q K T R S - Q K T R S - Q K T R S

Hence, the correct answer is **"K R Q T S Q T".**
